translations.web: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.
translations.bsb: Generations come and generations go, but the earth remains forever.
translations.kjv: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.
translations.asv: One generation goeth, and another generation cometh; but the earth abideth for ever.
